name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Expert on why the cyclospora parasite has been so hard to track
changes.summary: Julie Swann, head of the department of industrial and systems engineering at North Carolina State University, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss the tracking and tracing underway as the U.S.' cyclosporiasis outbreak surpasses 4,000 cases.

changes.title: Remembering the 4 U.S. service members killed recently in the Iran war
changes.summary: A dignified transfer was held Wednesday for the four U.S. Army soldiers killed in the Middle East in recent days amid the ongoing war with Iran. Lindsey Reiser shares more details on Lt. Tyler James Feehan, Pvt. Isabella Gonzales, Sgt. Angel Rampersad and Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton.

changes.title: What Visuals Show About Recent Damage to U.S. Military Sites in the Middle East
changes.summary: Video footage and satellite images reveal new details about Iranian strikes on U.S. targets during the latest flare-up in fighting.

changes.title: The White House pushes healthy eating. It cut a landmark nutrition education program
changes.summary: Nutrition advocates and public health experts are mystified by the decision to eliminate SNAP-Ed, given the Trump administration's embrace of the Make America Healthy Again agenda. (Image credit: Rachel Wisniewski for NPR).

changes.title: U.S. Employers Forced to Fire Thousands of Immigrants, and a Showdown over Peptides
changes.summary: Plus, America says no thanks to salad.

changes.title: U.S.-Saudi Deal Prompts Fears of a Nuclear Arms Race
changes.summary: In Europe, Asia and the Middle East, countries seek nuclear capabilities to hedge against aggressive neighbors and a receding Washington, potentially creating a more freewheeling era.

changes.title: U.S. Military Presence in Jordan Makes It Iranian Target
changes.summary: Relying heavily on U.S. aid and protection, Jordan is unlikely to restrict the American military presence there, despite escalating Iranian airstrikes.

changes.title: U.S.-Saudi Nuclear Deal Stokes Israeli Concerns of Mideast Arms Race
changes.summary: An Israeli minister sought to downplay the agreement, while critics said it could spur other regional countries to pursue a nuclear program, and potentially the creation of a bomb.

changes.title: Trump’s 50% Tariffs on Canada: What to Know, and What’s Next
changes.summary: The president said punishing 50 percent tariffs would begin by Aug. 19, a significant escalation of the trade war between Canada and the U.S. that he started over a year ago.
